note: A face on a concordance page is a warning as much as an illustration. These pages gather everyone of a name; the picture belongs to one of them. Each entry says which.

carlo-de-franceschi.whose: Carlo De Franceschi, 1809–1893, the historian of Istria and this family's own — the only man on this page whose likeness is known.

domenico-de-franceschi.whose: Domenico de' Franceschi, the Venetian printer who issued Palladio's «I quattro libri dell'architettura» in 1570 and the woodcut of Charles V storming La Goletta.
domenico-de-franceschi.note: Every other Domenico gathered on this page is an Istrian or Carnian villager, and no connection to the press is claimed.

francesco-de-franceschi.whose: Francesco de' Franceschi, the Venetian painter active 1443–1468 — the Ashmolean panels and the Correr Martyrdom of St Mamas.
francesco-de-franceschi.note: None of the other men of this name on this page is the painter.

francesco-franceschi.whose: Francesco Franceschi, the Venetian printer who died about 1599 — the title page of his 1565 Alberti at the Biblioteca Estense.

andrea-dei-franceschi.whose: Andrea dei Franceschi, 1473–1552, Grand Chancellor of Venice, painted by Titian.

andrea-de-franceschi.whose: Andrea dei Franceschi the Grand Chancellor, by Titian. Not the men of the parish registers on this page.
andrea-de-franceschi.note: The spelling differs by a letter and the two are routinely confused. They should not be.

mariano-de-franceschi.whose: Mariano de Franceschi, born 1849, the Roman painter.
